To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Can't accept Coupa invite — getting redirect loop

Hi Ben,

We received the supplier portal invite for Veridian from the Redwood onboarding email this morning, but when I click Accept I go into a redirect loop and never land on the profile setup page. I tried in Chrome on macOS and Safari on iOS — same behavior. The browser shows repeated redirects to the same Coupa URL and then back to our company SSO.

I've attached a quick screenshot of the browser console/network panel (screenshot-invite-redirect.png) and a short video of the redirect behavior (not attached here — let me know if you need it).

We have a PO waiting to be mapped to the new account; if we can't complete onboarding today it will delay the shipment. Can you escalate?

Thanks,
Samira Khan

Hi Samira — sorry for the trouble and thanks for the quick heads-up.

I'm looping in Jonas (our infra/serving runtime lead) and Laura from onboarding so we can troubleshoot. Quick asks while we investigate:
- Can you try the invite in an incognito/private window and let me know if that changes anything?
- If you can, please forward any browser network trace (HAR) or the short video — that usually helps.

Jonas, attaching Samira's screenshot — they hit a redirect loop between Coupa and their IdP. PO is time-sensitive (Veridian). Can you triage routing/RelayState handling? If needed we can generate a one-off short invite link to bypass the flow.

Samira — I'll stay on this until it's resolved.

Best,

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@veridianmanufacturing.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Can't accept Coupa invite — getting redirect loop

Hi Samira / Ben — quick update from infra.

Thanks for the screenshot, Samira. I pulled the initial accept flow logs for the invite token you referenced and see the following pattern: when the invite handler constructs the SAML RelayState we occasionally exceed the URL-safe length on some older vendor IdPs; that causes the IdP to truncate the RelayState and then a subsequent Coupa redirect comes back without the original context, which our redirect guard then interprets as a retry and sends the user back — producing the loop.

Short-term workaround (try this first):
1) Use this alternate short-link I generated that encodes the token server-side: https://app.coupa.com/invite/short?token=REDACTED
2) Open in a private/incognito window (clears cookie collisions with prior Coupa sessions).

We've also attached a small trace I extracted showing the truncated RelayState (relaystate-trace.txt) — see the repeated GET/302 sequence.

Longer-term fix: we'll update the invite generator to store RelayState server-side and issue a short opaque token for the handoff to Coupa so URLs are always short. I can scope a rollout and aim to deploy a safe fallback in the next patch window (ETA 5 business days) — Ben/Laura I'll follow up with a PR/rollout plan.

Samira — can you try the short link and let us know? If it still fails we'll collect the HAR and escalate to Coupa support with the truncated RelayState example.

- Jonas Weber
Principal Software Engineer, Infra
jonas_weber@redwood.com
[Attachment: relaystate-trace.txt (text/plain)]
